mechanism.claim: When eight-hour high-low travel becomes extreme relative to realized candle-body movement, the auction has fractured into rejected excursions rather than efficient directional displacement. Fade the completed final two-hour impulse for eight elapsed hours at the onset of that state.
mechanism.side: negative strict sign of the final 24 completed five-minute bars' open-to-close return
mechanism.why_distinct: RBEFR uses the ratio of summed Parkinson-style intrabar range variance to summed candle-body variance. It is not wick-side imbalance, semivariance direction, bipower jump size, variance-ratio serial dependence, close location, funding, flow, or a fitted model.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: large intrabar travel with weak body efficiency is itself a volatile-auction geometry; causal RV20 q90 remains only a later audit
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: top-15% strictly-prior fracture crossings with an eight-hour global reservation

features.body_variance: sum(log(close/open)^2) over all 96 bars; strict positive denominator
features.fracture_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 1080 valid decisions, minimum 720, current excluded
features.onset: current fracture_rank>=0.85 and immediately preceding exact two-hour decision fracture_rank<0.85
features.impulse: log(last close/first open) over final 24 completed bars, strict nonzero
features.source_valid: each five-minute aggregate has exactly five unique coherent finite positive-OHLC one-minute rows; no imputation

rv20_stress_slice.rv20: sqrt(365*mean exact daily returns^2 over t-20 through t-1)
rv20_stress_slice.threshold: numpy linear q90 over 756 strictly prior available RV20 observations
rv20_stress_slice.future_use: only after all sequential full-calendar stages pass

clock.decision: exact 2-hour UTC boundary after all 96 bars complete
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not an input; exact realized funding only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final
post_stage_volatility_audit.persistent_long_vol_comparator: same accepted clock and 0.5 gross, side forced long
post_stage_volatility_audit.rv20_q90_decomposition: same decomposition on causal RV20 q90 decisions

definitions.raw_range_variance_tail: strict-prior top-15% raw range-variance crossing, fading the same impulse
definitions.inverse_body_variance_tail: strict-prior top-15% reciprocal body-variance crossing, fading the same impulse
definitions.one_decision_stale_fracture: primary formula shifted by one exact two-hour decision

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no estimator, rank, history, onset, impulse, side, clock, hold, RV20, subset, comparator, control, or gate repair
